title: Who We Help — Ophthalytics
description: Advancing eye care across every stage of the patient journey.

sections.label: Hero
sections.heading: Advancing Eye Care Across Every Stage of the Patient Journey

sections.label: Intro statement
paragraphs: Ophthalytics supports healthcare providers, researchers, and organizations through AI-powered solutions designed for screening, diagnosis, and clinical research.
From primary care to optometry to pharmaceutical trials, our products are built to address real-world gaps in detection, decision-making, and patient access.

sections.label: Nsight360
sections.tagline: For Primary Care, Population Health, and Screening Programs
sections.heading: Bringing retinal screening to the frontlines of care
sections.body: Nsight360 is designed for healthcare providers who want to deliver accessible, efficient retinal screening at the point of care. By enabling non-specialists to perform eye exams, it expands access and helps close critical care gaps.

photo.alt: Field eye examination in an underserved community

benefits: Enables retinal screening without requiring an on-site eye specialist
Supports early detection of diabetic retinopathy
Improves workflow efficiency and patient throughput
Helps close care gaps and improve quality measures
sections.closing: Nsight360 makes it possible to identify at-risk patients earlier—where they already receive care.

image.alt: 95% compliance rate — diabetic retinopathy screening with Nsight360

sections.label: 2nd Opinion
sections.tagline: For Optometrists and Eye Care Professionals
sections.heading: Enhancing confidence in retinal assessments
sections.body: 2nd Opinion is built for optometrists and eye care providers who want additional support in interpreting retinal images, especially in complex or borderline cases.
benefits: Highlights suspicious regions and potential lesions
Supports clinical decision-making in uncertain cases
sections.closing: In everyday practice, not every case is clear-cut. 2nd Opinion provides an added layer of insight—helping clinicians see more and decide with greater confidence.

sections.label: Ophthal360
sections.tagline: For High-Volume Screening and Autonomous Deployment
sections.heading: Autonomous AI for scale and reach
sections.body: Ophthal360 is designed for organizations delivering retinal screening at scale—healthcare systems, large screening programs, and partners serving high-volume markets. Currently in active deployment in Asian markets, Ophthal360 enables rapid, consistent detection with minimal manual intervention.
benefits: Performs retinal analysis and generates screening outputs without manual interpretation
Optimized for large-scale deployment in clinics, screening programs, and population health initiatives
Identifies at-risk patients and supports timely referral decisions
Accelerates recruitment and enrollment timelines for trials
Supports consistent evaluation across sites and geographies
sections.closing: Ophthal360 makes it possible to deliver screening coverage at a scale no specialist-dependent model can match.

sections.label: National impact (US)
sections.heading: National Impact
sections.subheading: Redefining American Eye Care Through Intelligence
paragraphs: Ophthalytics is advancing the future of preventive eye care across the United States — partnering with health systems, community clinics, and policymakers to bring AI-powered retinal screening to the populations that need it most.
From Congressional telehealth showcases to federally qualified health centers, our technology is earning recognition as a critical tool in closing the diabetic eye care gap in America.

image.alt: Ophthalytics team at the U.S. House of Representatives showcasing AI-assisted eye screening

sections.label: International impact (Pakistan)
sections.heading: International Impact
paragraphs: Recognizing the crucial need to reach underserved communities, we have forged powerful partnerships to amplify our impact. Through dynamic collaborations with The Diabetes Centre and the Layton Rahmatulla Benevolent Trust, we are bringing our services to rural and marginalized populations in Pakistan.
By harnessing Nsight360, we are breaking down barriers to access, ensuring that individuals in these communities receive the essential diabetic eye exams they deserve.

image.alt: Ophthalytics team with The Diabetes Centre partners in Pakistan

sections.label: Final CTA
sections.heading: Find the Right Solution for Your Practice
sections.body: Whether you are delivering care, supporting diagnosis, or advancing research, Ophthalytics provides AI-powered tools designed for your needs.
